answer.rationale: The two live symptoms are activation (-6% QoQ) and onboarding completion (-4% QoQ), and onboarding completion is plausibly upstream of activation, so fixing the funnel entry addresses both with one slot. memory_86 and memory_31 are the load-bearing evidence for that direction, so those are the two I spend verification budget on: memory_31 is the oldest record (day 12) and most at risk of staleness or of having been superseded by later signup changes, and memory_86 is the most recent and most directly on-point claim. If the archived records show the lifts were small, measured on a since-changed funnel, or confounded with other launches, I would switch the slot to activation_messaging (memory_91), which targets the same decline through a different mechanism. Promotional_pricing is the tempting response to the competitor's entry pricing, and it is exactly what I am declining: memory_73 records a 31% activation and 18% revenue gain that came with a 12-point retention drop at renewal, and it explicitly warns against generalising. Under a primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue, that trade buys a quarter of headline numbers and sells the renewal base; matching a price war also invites a durable margin reset we cannot unwind. Referral_incentive (memory_57) is clean but was proven in established customers and does not touch the SMB funnel that is actually bleeding; enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is a different segment entirely and does not address either declining metric. Caveats I am carrying forward rather than resolving: all six memories are consolidated summaries with archived sources, so effect sizes are compressed and I cannot see confidence intervals or sample sizes for most; none of the prior wins were measured under active competitive price pressure, so historical lifts may not transfer; and the observed declines could be driven by adverse mix from the competitor skimming price-sensitive accounts rather than by funnel degradation, in which case an onboarding fix will underperform its historical effect. Standard experiment scale with a renewal-cohort retention guardrail alongside the activation and completion primaries, so the result is readable rather than merely directional.
